state_features: exact frozen B2 64D; G1 accesses raw_traj_score only (index56), not normalized/clipped accept_score
score: raw score of assigned current proposal, float32 feature index56

conditions.G0: frozen GMT OFF; exact prediction/metric SHA control
conditions.G1: one trainable global scalar threshold on current raw proposal score only; binary ACCEPT_CURRENT/START_NEW
conditions.G2: 64D state-conditioned scalar tau; two-layer GELU conditioner hidden154, approximately34K parameters; strict binary gate; no REASSOCIATE and no alternate-score maximum in START_NEW logit
conditions.G3: same34,080-parameter JEV architecture and initialization seed as B2; trained only on legal ACCEPT_CURRENT/START_NEW actions
conditions.G4a: frozen B2 weights, every chosen REASSOCIATE replaced by START_NEW; future state and actions recomputed
conditions.G4b: frozen B2 weights, every chosen REASSOCIATE replaced by ACCEPT_CURRENT; future state and actions recomputed
conditions.G5: frozen unmodified 3-action B2; exact prediction/metric SHA control

binary_target_contract: condition original utility softmax on retained legal actions; recompute best_actions on retained utility; preserve all feature/question/sequence/order/weight rows. If original probabilities underflow, compute double-precision retained utility softmax at original labeling.temperature. No forced old REASSOCIATE target folded into arbitrary replacement action.
checkpoint_selection: fixed last epoch; no video01 tuning
equivalence_definition: both absolute HOTA and AssA differences <=0.10 points; descriptive equivalence on this diagnostic, not statistical equivalence proof
structured_match_claim_PASS: G5 exceeds G3 by >=0.10 HOTA/AssA, G3 exceeds G2 by >=0.10 HOTA/AssA, and G5 exceeds both G4 replacements by >=0.10 HOTA/AssA; otherwise claim not established. Further event evidence and heldouts required for WWW GO.
first_stop_condition: if G5,G3,G2 mutually equivalent, do not expand dataset/model/unified training; reevaluate novelty and finish bounded diagnostics/heldouts
